# compass · Art Direction v3.1 pilot

Tool: built-in image_gen.imagegen. Generated 2026-11-16. Status: pilot, awaiting in-page visual direction selection.

Use case: illustration-story. Independent small asset aa_home_compass_01 for Atelier Atlas. ONE antique pocket surveying compass, closed body viewed gently oblique from above, intact shallow circular brass case and a single coherent graphite needle on an unlettered warm-bone dial. Original interpretive editorial object, not an authenticated historical instrument. Exceptionally restrained brass wash, graphite fine engraved hatching, small dark wood side accents, matte surfaces and precise delicate linework, same refined natural-history atlas family as a botanical frond. Full isolated silhouette centered at 65 percent of square canvas, actual transparent background with generous negative space. At 120–200px it must remain clean and legible. No paper backdrop, no scenery, no shadow on ground, no glowing edge, no readable lettering or numbers, no tick clutter, no floating disconnected parts, no other instruments, no collage, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no shiny 3D.
